description: Turn this flake of shell and it shifts green to violet. The dune gave it up; whatever grew it is long fossil.
lore: The broken edge is not one thing. It is about four hundred things, stacked: layer on layer on layer, each one a season of some flat, patient animal adding a little more house. That is all the colour is. Not a pigment — a count. Green going to violet is what four hundred years of doing the same small job, once a year, does to daylight coming through it. The water it worked in has been gone from that country since before anyone woke there. The sand turned its back plate up in a clean hollow behind a [[monsters/dune_digger|delver]], and somebody dropped it in a bag with eleven other flakes and walked on, and it is worth sixty gold. The patient are not paid at a better rate than anyone else.
gm_notes: Nacre as a legible record of duration — a shell is proof of a specific patience, and the layers can be counted. The flat ending is the point; do not warm it up.
